title: PC Assembly Lab
heading: Build it. Understand it.
reference: REFERENCE 01 · mATX / AM4 / DDR4 / PCIe GPU / SATA SSD / ATX PSU
readyHint: Every component and connection is in place. Run the power-on check.
twoEnds: Connect both labelled endpoints. Physical overlap does not make an electrical connection.
interactionHint: Drag hardware onto its highlighted mount, or select a part and choose its target.
restored: Your saved build has been restored. Power remains off until you run the checks.
runningHint: Explore your running build. Turn it off before changing hardware.
simulation: Educational hardware simulation · not an electrical or firmware emulator

issues.wrongTarget: This part does not fit that mount. Choose its amber target.
issues.occupied: This slot is already occupied. Remove its module first.
issues.dependency: Complete or remove the indicated dependency first.
issues.coolerBlocks: Remove the cooler before accessing the CPU socket.
issues.disconnectFirst: Unplug the indicated cable before removing the component.
issues.powerOff: Turn off the simulated PC before changing hardware.
issues.panelClosed: Remove the side panel before installing internal parts.
issues.missingPart: Power-on check failed: a required part is missing.
issues.missingCable: Power-on check failed: a required connection is missing.
issues.wrongPort: Connector mismatch. Use the two endpoints labelled for this cable.
issues.pickPart: Select a cable before choosing its endpoints.
issues.peripheralsFirst: Unplug peripherals before changing the required hardware or cables.
issues.fixedPart: The display is fixed. Connect its power and display cables.
issues.exploreOnly: Switch to Assemble to modify the build.

motherboard.name: Motherboard
motherboard.about: The mATX board links the processor, memory, storage and expansion hardware.
motherboard.hint: Seat it on the case standoffs with the rear I/O toward the back.

cpu.name: AM4 CPU
cpu.about: The reference processor uses an AM4 socket and compatible DDR4 memory.
cpu.hint: Match the gold corner with the socket key. Install before the cooler.

cooler.name: CPU cooler
cooler.about: The cooler transfers heat from the processor into its fins and airflow.
cooler.hint: Seat the contact plate over the CPU, then connect CPU_FAN.

ram1.name: DDR4 module 1
ram1.about: Working memory holds data used by the running system.
ram1.hint: Align the keyed contact edge with A2 or B2. Each slot holds one module.

ram2.name: DDR4 module 2
ram2.about: A matching second DDR4 module completes the reference memory pair.
ram2.hint: Use the other highlighted DIMM slot; occupied slots cannot be reused.

gpu.name: Graphics card
gpu.about: A discrete PCIe graphics card supplies the monitor signal in this reference build.
gpu.hint: Seat the edge connector in PCIe x16, align rear outputs, and connect auxiliary power.

ssd.name: SATA SSD
ssd.about: This 2.5-inch SSD uses separate SATA data and SATA power connections.
ssd.hint: Mount it on the drive tray above the PSU shroud. Connect both cables.

psu.name: ATX power supply
psu.about: The ATX supply distributes power to the motherboard, GPU and drive.
psu.hint: Fit it in the lower rear bay. AC power is separate from internal DC cables.

fanFront.name: Front intake fan
fanFront.about: The front fan brings air into the case.
fanFront.hint: Fit the front mount, then connect its motherboard fan header.

fanRear.name: Rear exhaust fan
fanRear.about: The rear fan carries warmed air out of the case.
fanRear.hint: Fit the upper rear mount and connect its own fan header.

monitor.name: Monitor
monitor.about: The external display needs both power and a signal from the graphics card.
monitor.hint: The display stays at its station. Connect GPU output and monitor power, then run the power-on check.

atx.name: 24-pin ATX
atx.about: Main motherboard power: PSU ATX output to the board's 24-pin connector.

eps.name: 8-pin CPU EPS
eps.about: Dedicated CPU power. EPS is distinct from the GPU power connector.

pcie.name: GPU auxiliary power
pcie.about: Connect the PSU PCIe lead to the graphics card. Do not substitute CPU EPS.

sataData.name: SATA data
sataData.about: A data path from the motherboard SATA port to the SSD.

sataPower.name: SATA power
sataPower.about: A separate PSU lead powers the SATA SSD.

display.name: Display cable
display.about: Connect the graphics card output to the monitor input.

psuAC.name: PSU AC power
psuAC.about: Connect the external power inlet to the workstation's simulated outlet.

monitorAC.name: Monitor power
monitorAC.about: The monitor has its own external power connection.

frontFan.name: Front fan lead
frontFan.about: Connect the intake fan to SYS_FAN 1.

rearFan.name: Rear fan lead
rearFan.about: Connect the exhaust fan to SYS_FAN 2.

coolerFan.name: CPU fan lead
coolerFan.about: Connect the cooler fan to CPU_FAN, separate from CPU EPS power.

optionalHint: Optional additions are separate from the required build. Front ports need their internal leads. Devices respond only after a complete, running base build.
opticalHint: Fit the optional drive in the upper 5.25-inch front bay. Connect its separate SATA data and power leads. Open the tray to insert a disc.
notConnected: Not connected: attach this front port’s internal lead first.
portReady: Port available. Compatible devices respond when the completed PC is running.
legendHint: Colors are an educational convention. Match connector shape and labelled endpoints, never color alone.
legendPower: Power · ATX 24, EPS 4+4, PCIe 6+2, SATA L, IEC
legendData: Data · SATA L, display, USB headers
legendAudio: Signal · fan headers, HD Audio, F_PANEL

plugHints.usbA: Use a USB-A socket. Front USB-A needs its internal USB header lead.
plugHints.usbC: Use USB-C only. The front USB-C header lead must be attached.
plugHints.headphones: Use the headphone / green line-out jack, not the microphone input.
plugHints.microphone: This is a microphone plug; use the pink microphone jack.
plugHints.disc: Use the open optical tray with its SATA data and power attached.

extensionIssues.completeFirst: Complete the required 22/22 build first. Optional parts never change that requirement.
extensionIssues.powerFirst: Power on the completed PC to use peripherals.
extensionIssues.portMismatch: This plug does not fit this port. Follow the compatible connector hint.
extensionIssues.portBusy: This port is occupied. Unplug its device first.
extensionIssues.leadMissing: Front port not connected. Attach the corresponding internal lead first.
extensionIssues.trayClosed: Open the optical tray before inserting a disc.
extensionIssues.driveUnwired: Connect optical SATA data and SATA power first.
extensionIssues.panelClosed: Open the side panel before changing internal hardware.
extensionIssues.powerOff: Turn off the simulated PC before changing internal hardware.
extensionIssues.dependency: Install the motherboard / optical drive and PSU required by this lead.
extensionIssues.disconnectFirst: Unplug the drive cables and remove its disc first.
extensionIssues.wrongPort: Use the two labelled endpoints for this optional lead.

displayHint: Connect GPU output and power on the assembled PC.

learning.label: Learning mode
learning.exploreHint: Select hardware to inspect it and learn its role. Switch to Assemble to change the build.

trouble.choose: Find the cause. Test the repair.
trouble.copyNotice: Faults run in a separate copy. Your assembly, optional devices and saved progress are kept for your return.
trouble.introduce: Introduce fault into my completed build
trouble.incomplete: Complete the assembly first, or use a separate reference practice system.
trouble.practiceCopy: Reference practice copy · original build preserved
trouble.yourCopy: Copy of your completed build · original preserved
trouble.correctObservation: That matches the simulated state at the time of your check.
trouble.checkAgain: That differs from the simulated state. Inspect the highlighted path and try again.
trouble.powerOffRepair: Switch simulated power off before changing parts or connections.
trouble.repairThenTest: Use the repair controls, then test the system again.
trouble.notTested: Run the test to observe the simulated failure.

desktop.label: Simulated desktop
desktop.typeHint: Click the monitor and type here. Escape releases keyboard focus.
desktop.pointerHint: Move your pointer over the monitor to control its cursor.

ui.sheetSize: Change sheet height: peek, half, full

auto.notReady: Wait for the workbench to be ready, then try again.
auto.assembleMode: Choose Assemble mode to install hardware. Guided and Free assembly are both supported.
auto.finishDrag: Finish moving the current part before starting.
